status: Computational screening model for a low-GWP gas-insulated current transformer

data_provenance.electric_field: actual COMSOL 6.2 solver outputs represented by the independently validated Kriging model
data_provenance.thermal_properties: NIST 300 K reference values and an explicit Wassiljewa/Wilke-type mixing rule
data_provenance.breakdown: literature-constrained scenario inputs; not validated ternary 100 mm CT measurements
data_provenance.detection_and_cost: declared dimensionless scenario proxies; not measurements or supplier quotations

NSGA_II.selection: deterministic farthest-point subset in normalized five-objective space from the final nondominated set

Monte_Carlo.composition_constraint: additive Gaussian perturbation, nonnegative clipping, then unit-sum renormalization
Monte_Carlo.surrogate_uncertainty: Gaussian residual with sigma=0.04625271143248838 kV/mm from the independent validation RMSE
Monte_Carlo.breakdown_model_uncertainty: multiplicative clipped-normal factor: draw N(1, 0.08^2), then clip to [0.76,1.24]; not a rejection-sampled truncated normal

claim_limit: The dataset demonstrates the method and supports candidate screening. It does not establish a unique engineering optimum or experimental qualification. Selected composition is expected to change when the helium breakdown input, cost basis, temperature, or objective preferences change.
electric_field_scope: Original physics-controlled medium-mesh gas-domain maximum with sharp floating-electrode ends; independent rounded-end mesh checks do not refit this surrogate or resolve its sharp-end bias.
reproducibility: Stored inputs, ordered random draws and fixed software versions define the numerical experiments; seeds identify designs and runs rather than dates.
